description: This script performs database schema updates and data migration for support issue priorities and service level agreements in an ERP system, using the Frappe framework.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function that reloads documents and calls other setup functions for support issue priorities and service levels.

methods.name: set_issue_priority
methods.description: Creates Issue Priority records for each priority option in the Issue doctype if they do not already exist.

methods.name: set_priority_for_issue
methods.description: Updates existing Issue records to set their priority field based on current data.

methods.name: set_priorities_service_level
methods.description: Migrates priority-related fields to a child table in Service Level documents, handling multiple priorities.

methods.name: set_priorities_service_level_agreement
methods.description: Migrates priority-related fields to a child table in Service Level Agreement documents, handling multiple priorities and setting entity type.
